approach: Add InterventionCategory::Mistake (ALL becomes 9). One rule, records::is_mistake(category, what): category mistake, or category other with `what` starting "Mistake:" (documented in a doc comment; records never rewritten). A pure status::mistake_report(&Records) returns total, counts per class_of_work, counts per cause (the recorded introspection's cause text grouped by introspect::normalise; no introspection counts under "no cause recorded"), and one prevention proposal per normalised cause (kind shown as check, knowledge or design change; introspection ids; mistakes covered). StatusView gets a `mistakes` field apart from interventions_by_category. Athena::mistakes() exposes it. display::mistakes renders it (status prints it when total > 0); display::audit_report(report, Option<&Audited>) renders the audit output. Command::Audit in main.rs prints the mistake report before athena.audit, so it appears when the audit is None or errors; JSON is one object with mistakes, audit (nullable), invocation. Introspection prompts for mistake events gain a top-level `mistake_guidance` key. README, CHANGELOG and the athena-v0.md category row name the category. Every criterion maps to a named test. Criterion 6 is shown by the three check commands, with a fails_without tied to named new tests and the full-suite compile.

decisions.choice: Compute counts and proposals in code from stored records via pure mistake_report; no new record type.
decisions.reason: No schema change or migration; legacy records follow the same rule; testable and shared by status, JSON and audit.

rejected.why: Adds schema and migration not needed.
Out of scope; records are immutable.

decisions.choice: Cause = introspection cause text grouped by normalise(); class = class_of_work.
decisions.reason: A mistake has no cause field; the introspection records it and normalise exists.

rejected.why: That is a class of failure, not a cause.
Schema change; deny_unknown_fields breaks older readers.

decisions.choice: Print the mistake report in Command::Audit before athena.audit, rendered through display::audit_report.
decisions.reason: Counts must print when no job audit is produced, or when the audit errors.

rejected.why: Sits behind the early return, as in the rejected attempt.

decisions.choice: Status prints mistakes only when total > 0; audit always prints ('mistakes none' at zero).
decisions.reason: Existing status output assertions stay unchanged.

rejected.why: Risks breaking existing assertions for no gain.

decisions.choice: Leave reading.rs unedited unless the compiler requires it.
decisions.reason: It does not depend on the category set.

steps: Read the status test in lifecycle.rs (~1118) and the Model in introspection.rs to reuse fixtures.

risks.mitigation: Keep audit and invocation keys, add mistakes; audit null when none. No existing test reads it.

risks.risk: New status line shifts existing assertions.
risks.mitigation: Print only when total > 0; JSON only adds a key.

demonstrations.observes: ALL contains Mistake, parse("mistake") is Some, intervene commits category Mistake, and a bogus category errors with text listing mistake.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the Mistake variant parse returns None, intervene bails on "mistake", and the ALL assertion fails.

demonstrations.method: lifecycle.rs `status_reports_mistakes_per_class_and_per_cause_apart_from_categories`: 3 mistakes (2 docs, 1 code), two sharing a cause by normalisation; asserts StatusView.mistakes, display::status text, and `athena status --json` by_class/by_cause with interventions_by_category holding only "mistake": 3.
demonstrations.observes: Per-class and per-cause counts in text and JSON, in fields separate from interventions_by_category.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the mistakes field there is no "mistakes" JSON key and no status text line; assertions fail.

demonstrations.method: auditor.rs `the_audit_output_reports_mistakes_per_class_and_per_cause` (audit Some) and `the_audit_output_reports_mistakes_when_no_audit_is_produced` (nested, None); introspection.rs `athena_audit_prints_mistakes_before_any_audit` runs the binary `athena audit` with ATHENA_NESTED (fallback job-less repo where the audit errors) and asserts stdout counts.
demonstrations.observes: Audit output lists total, per-class and per-cause counts with an audit, with none, and when it errors.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without printing before the early return, the None and binary cases emit no mistake lines and fail.

demonstrations.method: introspection.rs `a_mistake_intervention_is_introspected_with_guidance_for_the_preventing_check_or_knowledge` (captured prompt has mistake_guidance; non-mistake prompts lack it) and `mistakes_with_the_same_cause_aggregate_into_one_proposal` (2 proposals, shared one covers 2 mistakes); status.rs kind-mapping unit test.
demonstrations.observes: Prompt asks for the preventing check or knowledge; proposal names kind and text; same-cause mistakes give one proposal.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the guidance key the prompt assertion fails; without cause grouping there are 3 proposals, not 2.

demonstrations.method: status.rs `a_legacy_other_record_starting_mistake_colon_is_counted_and_not_rewritten`, records.rs `is_mistake_rule`; lifecycle check that the stored record file is byte-identical and still shows under "other"; the rule is in the is_mistake doc comment.
demonstrations.observes: Legacy 'Mistake:' other records are counted in status and audit; 'A mistake:' is not; file unchanged.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the prefix rule the legacy record is missing from totals and assertions fail.

demonstrations.method: Run the three gates on the finished change. The new tests (criteria 1-5) are part of the suite, and the new enum variant and Option-taking display functions must compile everywhere they are used.
demonstrations.observes: clippy and fmt print no diagnostics (cargo fmt --check), and cargo test passes in full, including the new named tests and existing tests that use InterventionCategory.
demonstrations.fails_without: If the variant were unhandled or the new code malformed, the build, a clippy warning, a fmt diff or a failing new or existing test would fail the gates; a missing criterion test would show as absent from the cargo test output.

demonstrations.method: Status and audit tests assert rendered text shows the mistake total, classes and causes with counts above 1, and a 'prevention' line per proposal (kind and text). A lifecycle.rs test reads README.md, CHANGELOG.md and docs/design/athena-v0.md via include_str! and asserts each contains "mistake". The fresh-reader rating is prose-only, done by the reviewer.
demonstrations.observes: Output shows how many mistakes, recurring classes and causes, and proposed prevention; the three docs name the category.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the docs edits the include_str! assertions fail; without proposal lines the output assertions fail.

open_questions: Free-text causes only group when normalised text is equal; grouping by failure_class is a product choice.
Whether `athena audit` under ATHENA_NESTED works in the test environment was not run; fallback is a job-less repo where the audit errors after mistakes print.
